environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Python 3.9 runtime) deployed in the 'notification-service' namespace on EKS cluster. The Lambda is exposed via API Gateway (HTTP API, no authorization configured) with a direct integration. The function's IAM execution role has AmazonDynamoDB full access and SecretsManager read access for the account. No input validation middleware. The API Gateway endpoint is publicly accessible at https://api.example.com/render-template. No WAF attached to the API Gateway stage.

config.api_gateway: HTTP API, no authorizer, public endpoint
